title: fix(app-shell): "Discard draft" names the item by its label, not its machine id (objectui#12690)
body:
Fixes #12690
Clause-②: no

## What

Discarding a metadata draft in the Setup metadata editor named the item by its machine id, even when the item has a label. The confirm asked "Discard the pending draft for object/uxscratch_widget?" and the toast said "Draft discarded: object/uxscratch_widget". Both now name the label the item's loaded body carries ("QA Widget"), in English and Chinese. An item with no label still reads type/name, and the discard request is unchanged.

## How

- `ResourceEditPage.tsx` (`doDiscardDraft`) reads the subject once, before the discard: the trimmed `draft.label` when it is a non-empty string, otherwise `type/name`. That is the same body field the AI-chat editor context already reads, so there is no second label resolution. The page header was checked first: its breadcrumb shows the machine name, not the label.
- `metadata-admin/i18n.ts`: `engine.edit.discardDraftConfirm` and `engine.edit.draftDiscarded` take one `{item}` placeholder instead of `{type}/{name}`, in en and zh. This dictionary is module-local: the package exports only `.`, and the root barrel never re-exports it. So this is not a published key change, hence Clause-② no.
- `RuntimeDraftBar.tsx` (the view and report config panels) formats the same confirm key. It holds no label, so it now passes `item` as type/name. Its text is byte-identical, and a new test pins it. This file is outside the claim's surface (see the report).

## Tests

- New `ResourceEditPage.discardDraftLabel-12690.test.tsx` (the real page over a real MetadataClient with an in-memory server): en and zh-CN, the confirm and the toast name the label and not doc/NAME. CONTROL: an item with no label still reads doc/plain_note, and exactly one DELETE goes to the same package-less draft address.
- `ResourceEditPage.discardFeedback-12303.test.tsx`: the objectui#12303 pin is updated, not deleted. Its fixture's label equals its name, so it now expects the label form, and its header explains the change.
- `RuntimeDraftBar.test.tsx`: the discard confirm reads "Discard the pending draft for view/my_view?" with every placeholder filled.
- Ablation: dropping the label from the subject turns the en, zh and #12303 cases red while CONTROL stays green. Reverting RuntimeDraftBar to the old argument turns its new case red. Both restores were hash-checked against HEAD.
- Local gates at 18916e8: app-shell dependency build and type-check (src and tests), the metadata-admin and RuntimeDraftBar test family (72 files, 730 tests), check:i18n-keys, check:i18n-drift, check:i18n-dead-keys, check:changeset-claims and changeset presence all pass. ESLint shows no new findings against main (its 3 errors in ResourceEditPage.tsx are already on main).

## Live reading

Backend from e2e/live/ci/start-backend.sh (published @objectstack/*@18.0.0-next.2), console dev server proxied to it, an env-wide draft of object/uxscratch_widget labelled "QA Widget", discarded through the page:
- before (main 6e4f144): confirm "Discard the pending draft for object/uxscratch_widget?", toast "Draft discarded: object/uxscratch_widget"
- after (this branch): confirm "Discard the pending draft for QA Widget?", toast "Draft discarded: QA Widget"

Screenshots and readings are on branch claude/issue-12690-evidence, under evidence/12690/.

## Acceptance notes

- The item's label is taken from the body the editor holds, so a draft that renamed the label is named by the draft's label, the one on screen while discarding.
- Observed, not filed: the edit page's header breadcrumb names the item by its machine name even when it has a label.
